citations.assessment: The final list names Yaavetz son of Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi among those said to have entered the Garden of Eden in their lifetimes. Preserve the tradition as reported.

The Yalkut’s Ezekiel passage for the Eden verse in chapter 28 is remez 367 in the retrieved edition. It says Yaavetz was the son of Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi’s son, whereas Derekh Eretz Zuta simply calls him his son.
